test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which group of organisation/institutes is an example of Constitutional bodies in India?

options.text: Election Commission of India, Attorney General of India, Union Public Service Commission
National Human Right Commission, National Commission for Minorities, Election Commission of India
Comptroller and Auditor General of India, National Human Rights Commission, Election Commission of India
National Commission of India, Securities and Exchange Board of India, Attorney General of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Election Commission of India, Attorney General of India, Union Public Service Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Election Commission of India**: An autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India at both national and state levels.
 
• **Attorney General of India**: The chief legal advisor to the Government of India and is appointed by the President of India under Article 76 of the Constitution.
 
• **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**: A constitutional body that conducts examinations for the appointment to the services of the Union.
 
• These bodies are established by the Constitution of India and have a significant role in the governance and administration of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constitutional Bodies**: These are bodies in India that derive their powers and functions from the Constitution of India.
 
• They are mentioned in the Constitution and cannot be altered or abolished without a constitutional amendment.

 
• **Election Commission of India**

 
 
• Formed on January 25, 1950, it ensures free and fair elections in the country.
 
• It administers elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State Legislative Assemblies.
 
 
 
• **Attorney General of India**
 
 
• The highest law officer in the country, appointed by the President of India.
 
• He/she has the right of audience in all courts in India.
 
 
 
• **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**
 
 
• Formed on October 1, 1926, it is responsible for recruiting all the Group 'A' officers under the Government of India.
 
• It conducts the Civil Services Examination, Engineering Services Examination, and other competitive exams.
